name: Scourge Hook: Jagged Compass

description.content: When the trial starts, [4] random Hooks become Scourge Hooks.
Whenever a Survivor is unhooked, the Hook becomes a Scourge Hook.
Whenever you hook a Survivor on a Scourge Hook, for [10s], you see the Aura of the Generator with the most progress.

quote: "Drop anchor! I will chart us a new course." -Portia Maye
